video_title: John Collins talks joining Pistons: 'Different than what I've been used to at most other places'

quotes.speaker: John Collins
quotes.summary_phrase: John Collins on the Detroit Pistons' team culture and identity
quotes.excerpt: We're not trying to prove anything to anybody. We're going to come out, play hard, play our game
quotes.quote: While trying to prove that we are winners, championship retainers, etc., we're not trying to prove anything to anybody in that sense as well. We're going to come out, play hard, play our game and try to build good habits and try to prepare ourselves to win games.

quotes.speaker: John Collins
quotes.summary_phrase: John Collins on adjusting to the Detroit Pistons' team culture
quotes.excerpt: Most other players are just trying to get used to the Pistons culture and what we require
quotes.quote: It's been different than what I've been used to. Most other players are just trying to get used to the Pistons culture and what we require here as a player. Trending upward from camp to now to the few preseason games, I like our improvement and I like the energy, the vibe that we have here, so just trying to continue to improve and build on that.

quotes.speaker: John Collins
quotes.summary_phrase: John Collins on the unique identity of the Detroit Pistons
quotes.excerpt: The heart, the intensity, the grit, just the identity of who we are as Pistons is different
quotes.quote: The heart, the intensity, the grit, just the identity of who we are as Pistons is different historically. Even to now with JB, what he wants us to do and how he wants us to play. So, again, just trying to fit into the culture and bring what I can.

quotes.speaker: John Collins
quotes.summary_phrase: John Collins on building chemistry with Jalen Duren
quotes.excerpt: I feel like it's going to be fun to play with JD, especially with his vision
quotes.quote: We're talking about it a little bit, but I feel like with our athleticism, our ability to dominate the paint, I feel like it's going to be fun to play with JD, especially with his vision. I feel like I have some underrated vision, big-to-big vision. The big-to-big game is going to be fun to watch and I'm excited to play with JD in all aspects.
